content_of_post_to_comment:
I mean, its all about habituation, but how many of you got this feeling? Years of keeping in internet, watching everything and after that, theres no things that can give me happy.

Eckhart Tolle helpped me with that a bit, feeling slowly better now, but its hard to feel something. In somehow i feeling like an old witcher without any emotions, hoping that i die soon and dont be bother any family of mine.

Thats stupid, internet is stupid, even if theres still something good. Looking for the good thing in internet is now like swimming in cesspool, if this is correct word.

Its stupid.
comment: The “hoping that i die soon” part worries me more than the internet itself. When everything starts feeling dull, it can be hard to tell whether you've genuinely lost interest in life or just become exhausted by the constant stimulation. I'm glad Tolle has helped a little, but you shouldn't have to sit with those thoughts alone. Have you been feeling this way offline too?
